Happy Earth Month from National Geographic! Just a short distance from Los Angeles lies a chain of islands so wild they’re called the "Galápagos of North America." The Channel Islands, a hidden chain of wild islands lying in plain sight of Los Angeles, California, are home to plants and animals found nowhere else on Earth, like the tiny Island Fox, making it one of America's most magnificent National Parks.
